";
  }

  function inlineMarkdown(text) {
    return escapeHtml(text)
      .replace(/!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]+\)/g, "")
      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>")
      .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "<em>$1</em>");
  }

  function renderMarkdown(markdown) {
    var lines = markdown.replace(/\r/g, "").split("\n");
    var html = [];
    var paragraph = [];
    var quote = [];

    if (/^#\s/.test(lines[0] || "")) lines.shift();
    while (lines.length && (!lines[0].trim() || /^(日期|狀態):/.test(lines[0].trim()))) lines.shift();

    function flushParagraph() {
      if (paragraph.length) {
        html.push("<p>" + inlineMarkdown(paragraph.join("\n")).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + "</p>");
        paragraph = [];
      }
    }

    function flushQuote() {
      if (quote.length) {
        html.push("<blockquote>" + inlineMarkdown(quote.join(" ")) + "</blockquote>");
        quote = [];
      }
    }

    lines.forEach(function (line) {
      var trimmed = line.trim();
      if (/^!\[/.test(trimmed)) return;
      if (!trimmed) {
        flushParagraph();
        flushQuote();
        return;
      }
      if (/^---+$/.test(trimmed)) {
        flushParagraph();
        flushQuote();
        html.push("<hr>");
        return;
      }
      if (/^>/.test(trimmed)) {
        flushParagraph();
        quote.push(trimmed.replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
        return;
      }
      flushQuote();
      if (/^#{1,4}\s/.test(trimmed)) {
        flushParagraph();
        var level = Math.min(trimmed.match(/^#+/)[0].length + 2, 5);
        html.push("<h" + level + ">" + inlineMarkdown(trimmed.replace(/^#{1,4}\s+/, "")) + "</h" + level + ">");
        return;
      }
      if (/^[-*]\s/.test(trimmed)) {
        flushParagraph();
        html.push("<p class=\"bullet\">" + inlineMarkdown(trimmed.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, "")) + "</p>");
        return;
      }
      paragraph.push(trimmed);
    });
    flushParagraph();
    flushQuote();
    return html.join("");
  }

  function setText(id, value) {
    document.getElementById(id).textContent = value;
  }

  function renderSummary() {
    var finance = data.finance;
    var paidPercent = percentage(finance.paid, finance.total);
    var perPerson = finance.total / data.travelers;
    var perPersonDaily = perPerson / data.tripDays;
    var pendingPerson = finance.pending / data.travelers;

    setText("known-total", currency(finance.total));
    setText("paid-total", currency(finance.paid));
    setText("pending-total", currency(finance.pending));
    setText("per-person", currency(perPerson));
    setText("paid-caption", paidPercent + "% 已完成付款");
    setText("pending-caption", "每人約 " + currency(Math.round(pendingPerson)));
    setText("per-day", "平均每日約 " + currency(Math.round(perPersonDaily)));
    setText("donut-percent", paidPercent + "%");
    setText("paid-side", currency(finance.paid));
    setText("pending-side", currency(finance.pending));
    setText("personal-total", currency(perPerson));
    setText("daily-average", currency(Math.round(perPersonDaily)));
    setText("pending-average", currency(Math.round(pendingPerson)));
    document.getElementById("payment-donut").style.setProperty("--paid", paidPercent + "%");

    document.getElementById("personal-bars").innerHTML = finance.categories.map(function (category) {
      return '<div class="personal-line"><span>' + category.name + '</span><strong>' +
        currency(Math.round(category.amount / data.travelers)) + '</strong><small>每人</small></div>';
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderCountdown() {
    var start = new Date(data.departure);
    var now = new Date();
    var today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    var departure = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate());
    var days = Math.ceil((departure - today) / 86400000);
    setText("countdown", days > 0 ? days : days === 0 ? "今" : "已");
  }

  function renderDays() {
    var filter = document.getElementById("day-filter");
    var grid = document.getElementById("day-grid");
    var filters = [{ date: "all", label: "全部" }].concat(data.days.map(function (day) {
      return { date: day.date, label: day.date };
    }));

    filter.innerHTML = filters.map(function (item, index) {
      return '<button class="day-button' + (index === 0 ? " active" : "") + '" data-date="' +
        item.date + '" role="tab" aria-selected="' + (index === 0) + '">' + item.label + "</button>";
    }).join("");

    function showDays(date) {
      var selection = date === "all" ? data.days : data.days.filter(function (day) {
        return day.date === date;
      });
      grid.innerHTML = selection.map(function (day) {
        return '<article class="day-card">' +
          '<img class="day-photo" loading="lazy" src="' + day.photo + '" alt="' + day.photoAlt + '">' +
          '<div class="day-meta"><span>' + day.day + '</span><strong>' + day.date + '</strong></div>' +
          '<p class="day-city">' + day.city + '</p>' +
          '<h3>' + day.title + '</h3>' +
          '<ul>' + day.events.map(function (event) { return "<li>" + event + "</li>"; }).join("") + "</ul>" +
          '<div class="tag-row">' + day.tags.map(function (tag) { return "<span>" + tag + "</span>"; }).join("") + "</div>" +
          "</article>";
      }).join("");
    }

    filter.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!event.target.matches(".day-button")) return;
      filter.querySelectorAll(".day-button").forEach(function (button) {
        var active = button === event.target;
        button.classList.toggle("active", active);
        button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active));
      });
      showDays(event.target.dataset.date);
    });
    showDays("all");
  }

  function renderDetailedSchedule() {
    var tabs = document.getElementById("detail-days");
    var reader = document.getElementById("schedule-reader");
    tabs.innerHTML = content.detailedDays.map(function (day, index) {
      return '<button class="detail-button' + (index === 0 ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-index="' + index + '">' + day.date + "</button>";
    }).join("");

    function showDay(index) {
      var day = content.detailedDays[index];
      reader.innerHTML = '<div class="reader-title"><span>' + escapeHtml(day.day) + '</span><h4>' +
        escapeHtml(day.date) + ' 行程</h4><small>' + day.entries.length + ' 筆安排</small></div>' +
        '<div class="timeline">' + day.entries.map(function (entry) {
          var map = entry.map ? '<a href="' + escapeHtml(entry.map) +
            '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">地圖</a>' : "";
          return '<div class="timeline-row"><time>' + escapeHtml(entry.time) + '</time>' +
            '<span class="entry-kind">' + escapeHtml(entry.type) + '</span><div><p class="entry-city">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.city) + '</p><h5>' + escapeHtml(entry.title) + '</h5>' +
            (entry.note ? '<p class="entry-note">' + escapeHtml(entry.note).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + "</p>" : "") +
            '</div>' + map + "</div>";
        }).join("") + "</div>";
    }

    tabs.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!event.target.matches(".detail-button")) return;
      tabs.querySelectorAll(".detail-button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.classList.toggle("active", button === event.target);
      });
      showDay(Number(event.target.dataset.index));
    });
    showDay(0);
  }

  function renderFinance() {
    var finance = data.finance;
    document.getElementById("category-bars").innerHTML = finance.categories.map(function (category) {
      var share = percentage(category.amount, finance.total);
      return '<div class="bar-line">' +
        '<div><span>' + category.name + '</span><strong>' + currency(category.amount) + '</strong></div>' +
        '<div class="bar"><i class="' + category.tone + '" style="width:' + share + '%"></i></div>' +
        '<small>' + share + "%</small></div>";
    }).join("");

    document.getElementById("pending-ledger").innerHTML = finance.pendingItems.map(function (item) {
      return '<div class="ledger-row"><time>' + item.date + '</time><div><strong>' + item.name +
        '</strong><small>' + item.source + '</small></div><b>' + currency(item.amount) + "</b></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderAttractions() {
    var filter = document.getElementById("spot-filter");
    var grid = document.getElementById("spot-grid");
    var reader = document.getElementById("spot-reader");
    var regions = ["全部"].concat(content.articles.reduce(function (values, article) {
      if (values.indexOf(article.region) === -1) values.push(article.region);
      return values;
    }, []));
    var visible = content.articles;

    filter.innerHTML = regions.map(function (region, index) {
      return '<button class="spot-button' + (index === 0 ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-region="' + region + '">' + region + "</button>";
    }).join("");

    function openArticle(article, activeIndex) {
      var image = spotImage(article);
      reader.innerHTML = '<figure class="spot-photo"><img loading="lazy" src="' + image +
        '" alt="' + escapeHtml(article.title) + '景點照片"></figure><header class="reading-head"><p class="eyebrow">' + article.region +
        '</p><h3>' + escapeHtml(article.title) + '</h3><span>' + article.date + " · " +
        article.status + '</span></header><div class="markdown">' + renderMarkdown(article.markdown) + "</div>";
      grid.querySelectorAll(".spot-card").forEach(function (card, index) {
        card.classList.toggle("active", index === activeIndex);
      });
    }

    function showAttractions(region) {
      visible = region === "全部" ? content.articles : content.articles.filter(function (article) {
        return article.region === region;
      });
      grid.innerHTML = visible.map(function (article, index) {
        var image = spotImage(article);
        return '<button class="spot-card' + (index === 0 ? " active" : "") + '" data-index="' + index +
          '"><img loading="lazy" src="' + image + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(article.title) + '縮圖"><span>' + article.region + '</span><strong>' + escapeHtml(article.title) +
          '</strong><em>閱讀完整介紹</em></button>';
      }).join("");
      openArticle(visible[0], 0);
    }

    filter.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!event.target.matches(".spot-button")) return;
      filter.querySelectorAll(".spot-button").forEach(function (button) {
        button.classList.toggle("active", button === event.target);
      });
      showAttractions(event.target.dataset.region);
    });
    grid.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var button = event.target.closest(".spot-card");
      if (!button) return;
      openArticle(visible[Number(button.dataset.index)], Number(button.dataset.index));
    });
    showAttractions("全部");
  }

  function renderStays() {
    document.getElementById("stay-track").innerHTML = data.stays.map(function (stay) {
      var state = stay.status === "已付款" ? "success" : "alert";
      var documentText = stay.document ? "憑證已備" : "憑證待補";
      var photo = stay.photo ? '<figure class="stay-photo"><img loading="lazy" src="' +
        escapeHtml(stay.photo) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(stay.name) + '住宿照片"></figure>' : "";
      return '<article class="stay-card">' +
        photo +
        '<div class="stay-card-body">' +
        '<header><time>' + stay.date + '</time><span class="pill ' + state + '">' + stay.status + "</span></header>" +
        '<p>' + stay.city + " · " + stay.nights + "</p>" +
        '<h3>' + stay.name + "</h3>" +
        '<strong>' + currency(stay.price) + "</strong>" +
        '<footer><span>' + stay.detail + "</span><em>" + documentText + "</em></footer></div></article>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderMovement() {
    document.getElementById("flight-list").innerHTML = data.flights.map(function (flight) {
      return '<div class="flight"><time>' + flight.date + '</time><strong>' + flight.flight +
        '</strong><div><b>' + flight.path + '</b><small>' + flight.time + "</small></div></div>";
    }).join("");
    document.getElementById("transport-list").innerHTML = data.transport.map(function (transport) {
      return '<div class="transport"><span>' + transport.mode + '</span><div><strong>' +
        transport.title + '</strong><small>' + transport.when + " · " + transport.ref +
        '</small></div><b>' + currency(transport.amount) + "</b></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderTickets() {
    document.getElementById("ticket-list").innerHTML = data.tickets.map(function (ticket) {
      return '<div class="ticket"><time>' + ticket.date + '</time><div><strong>' + ticket.name +
        '</strong><small>' + ticket.guests + " · " + ticket.ref +
        '</small></div><b>' + currency(ticket.amount) + "</b></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderEpisodes() {
    var tabs = document.getElementById("episode-list");
    var reader = document.getElementById("episode-reader");
    tabs.innerHTML = content.episodes.map(function (episode, index) {
      return '<button class="episode-tab' + (index === 0 ? " active" : "") + '" data-index="' + index +
        '"><span>' + episode.number + '</span><strong>' + escapeHtml(episode.title) + "</strong></button>";
    }).join("");

    function showEpisode(index) {
      var episode = content.episodes[index];
      reader.innerHTML = '<header class="reading-head"><p class="eyebrow">' + episode.number +
        '</p><h3>' + escapeHtml(episode.title) + '</h3><span>' + episode.date + " · " +
        episode.status + '</span></header><div class="markdown">' + renderMarkdown(episode.markdown) + "</div>";
      tabs.querySelectorAll(".episode-tab").forEach(function (tab, tabIndex) {
        tab.classList.toggle("active", tabIndex === index);
      });
    }
    tabs.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var tab = event.target.closest(".episode-tab");
      if (!tab) return;
      showEpisode(Number(tab.dataset.index));
    });
    showEpisode(0);
  }

  function renderNotices() {
    document.getElementById("notice-grid").innerHTML = data.notices.map(function (notice) {
      return '<article class="notice"><span>' + notice.level + '</span><h3>' + notice.title +
        '</h3><p>' + notice.body + "</p></article>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function activateReveal() {
    var items = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
      items.forEach(function (item) { item.classList.add("visible"); });
      return;
    }
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    items.forEach(function (item) { observer.observe(item); });
  }

  renderSummary();
  renderCountdown();
  renderDays();
  renderDetailedSchedule();
  renderStays();
  renderMovement();
  renderTickets();
  renderAttractions();
  renderEpisodes();
  renderFinance();
  renderNotices();
  activateReveal();
}());

</script>
  </body>
</html>
